objective: Extend the existing Builder Control loop into the local-first AEGIS AI Engineering Command Center: a lean, executable multi-model and multi-tool operating system that binds reviews to an exact subject diff, routes specialist work to verified specialist tools, uses subscription execution before metered APIs, exposes process truth through a dashboard, and keeps deterministic tests/runtime evidence as the final technical authority.
constraints: Reuse the canonical Registry -> Task Packet -> Gate -> Ledger loop; do not create a second permission, evidence, or source-of-truth system.
The Product Owner and approved specifications govern intent; GitHub records machine truth; AI output is never evidence by itself.
Run cheap deterministic checks before expensive model reviews and route Grok only for high-risk, novel, security-sensitive, or milestone changes.
Claude may build but may not approve its own work; Codex reviews independently; Copilot guards PR repository integrity; Grok is read-only and adversarial.
Copilot review comments are not a substitute for required GitHub status checks or branch protection.
Do not create empty PRODUCT_SPEC, architecture, database, API, design, or security documents merely to satisfy a checklist; reconcile project-local sources that actually exist.
Do not edit application code, Vitalis canon, customer-facing artifacts, or the dirty primary worktree.
Keep prompts bounded: pass the requirement, authoritative paths, diff, test evidence, and explicit unverified items rather than whole conversation history.
Fail closed on missing review evidence, unresolved critical/high findings, or an unavailable required check; say UNAVAILABLE or UNVERIFIED rather than fabricate PASS.
Anti-theater: claim completion only with changed paths, commands, test outputs, reviewer evidence, checkpoint, rollback point, and known gaps in the same response.

CORRECTION PASS 1 (2026-08-23): the SUBJECT of a build is the changed paths minus control evidence (reviews, review-raw, packets, ledger). Reviews bind to the subject diff hash; adding review evidence must not change that hash.
CORRECTION PASS 1: required review gates fail closed by default. No report-only mode and no environment-variable opt-in may exist anywhere in the workflow or the CLI.

CORRECTION PASS 1: the terminal state is READY_FOR_DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION or READY_FOR_PR. Nothing is labelled DONE merely because review records exist. Runtime and deploy remain separate and unclaimed.
CORRECTION PASS 1: no shell interpolation of git refs anywhere; use argument-array process spawning and validate every ref against a strict pattern.
CORRECTION PASS 1: missing or unreadable protected-path policy is a hard block, never an empty allow-list.
CORRECTION PASS 1: reviewer adapters are read-only, preserve raw output, and never synthesise a PASS for a tool that did not run.
This is a generic build operating system installable in any repository. It is not a Vitalis feature and must not depend on any one application.
AEGIS is the observer and controller of the canonical Workflow Engine; the dashboard may never become a second workflow-state authority.
Route by task capability before model preference. A general model may not imitate a specialist tool when the Tool Capability Canon requires a specialist.
The default metered API budget is zero. Prefer verified subscription CLI, built-in, plugin/MCP, or desktop-assisted execution; metered execution requires explicit budget authorization.
A tool is selectable only when its availability is VERIFIED/AVAILABLE with evidence. Installed, mentioned, or visible in a screenshot is not equivalent to executable.
The Tool Capability Canon is switchable and extensible: tools may be enabled, disabled, or replaced without changing workflow doctrine.

AMENDMENT 2026-08-23 (Integration Bus): external connectors are WORKERS. No connector, automation platform, or integration may mark work VERIFIED, approve itself, declare tests or runtime PASS, suppress findings, create checkpoints, or override the watchdog or a human gate. Engineering authority stays in the control plane.
AMENDMENT: integration failure and engineering state are tracked SEPARATELY. A failed connector never downgrades verified engineering, and a failed sync is never reported as successful.
AMENDMENT: prefer the smallest reliable execution path. Direct API is preferred for simple reliable actions; Make is legacy/optional and is never the default substrate.
AMENDMENT: connector and event data must be real, typed, idempotent (operation/correlation id), observable, and fail honest.

AMENDMENT (JARVIS visual): every operational visual state must correspond to real system state. No fake activity, health, KPIs, progress, or completion. Missing data renders UNAVAILABLE, aged data renders STALE with a timestamp, unchecked claims render UNVERIFIED.
AMENDMENT (JARVIS visual): the 3D/spatial layer is optional and modular. The dashboard must be fully operational in 2D with WebGL disabled, and must honour prefers-reduced-motion.

AMENDMENT: the visual architect and the visual critic must be selected through the existing Tool/Model Router and must be different capabilities. The primary coding model is not automatically the visual architect.

KNOWLEDGE AMENDMENT (2026-08-24): Notion is a human knowledge mirror, never an authority. It may not declare tests passed, mark a feature verified, create a checkpoint, or override GitHub/runtime evidence. A Notion claim that disagrees with AEGIS renders as CONFLICT and requires a Product Owner decision.

KNOWLEDGE AMENDMENT: synchronization state is tracked separately from engineering state. A failed Notion sync never downgrades verified engineering, and a sync is never reported SYNCED unless the write actually occurred.

MODEL ROUTING (2026-08-24): Claude is the default orchestrator; Codex performs implementation review and verification; Grok is a BOUNDED adversarial reviewer. Routing considers capability, cost, availability, and data sensitivity, in that order of veto power.
MODEL ROUTING: recursive delegation is disabled by default. An agent may not spawn a sub-agent unless the policy explicitly permits it for that role.
MODEL ROUTING: every route carries a hard budget. Exceeding a declared budget is a refusal, not a warning, and metered execution additionally requires a named human and a cap.

HOSTING: the dashboard package is data-minimized — it serves a projection, never the repository, never raw reviewer transcripts, never the ledger. Authentication is required and bound to localhost by default.

CORRECTION CYCLE 2: review records are not evidence unless attested. The gate verifies an attestation covering subject hash, packet authorization digest, reviewer identity, model, disposition and findings. The attestation is machine-local and proves integrity, NOT human approval — that limit is stated wherever it is claimed.

CORRECTION CYCLE 2: the canonical ledger is the only evidence store and must be atomic and idempotent. Concurrent appends may not lose entries, and a repeated operationId is a no-op, never a duplicate effect.
REVIEW SCALABILITY (2026-08-25): a subject too large for one reviewer call is split into deterministic, coherent path groups. The same subject always yields the same groups.

REVIEW SCALABILITY: an aggregate verdict is consumable only when the union of its groups covers the subject EXACTLY — no gap, no overlap, no foreign path — every group is signed and verifies, and every group shares one reviewer and model.
REVIEW SCALABILITY: a timeout or UNAVAILABLE outcome must be attested or archived outside active reviews. An unsigned record is never left where the gate reads it.
RUNTIME (2026-08-25): the 11-step V1 contract is preserved in full. The runtime is built up to the contract; the contract is not reduced to the runtime.

RUNTIME: run state is working state, not authority. Every transition appends to the canonical ledger and every permission still comes from the task packet. No second gate, ledger, or permission system.
RUNTIME: an illegal state transition is refused, not coerced. A run cannot reach a later state by skipping an earlier one.
RUNTIME: cost projection is sourced ONLY from recorded telemetry. A run whose telemetry was lost is reported UNRECORDED — never estimated, never zero.
RUNTIME: rollback restores a recorded point. A checkpoint that cannot name its rollback point is refused.
stopConditions: The implementation would create a second gate, task-packet format, protected-path policy, or evidence ledger instead of extending Builder Control.
A required GitHub or Copilot capability is unavailable; report the exact capability as UNAVAILABLE instead of simulating it.
The implementation would require application, protocol, research-brain, pricing, or customer-facing changes.
A model needs a credential or password exposed in prompts, logs, or committed files.
Claude Code fails twice on the same implementation issue.
Marc issues STOP, delegate, canon, or source-of-truth interrupt language.
CORRECTION PASS 1: the work would require a commit, push, pull request, merge, or any GitHub settings mutation.
KNOWLEDGE AMENDMENT: the work would deploy, publish, release, expose the dashboard beyond localhost, or mutate any external service including Notion.
